Name: Junimo Dialog
Author: ceruleandeep
Description:
[size=3][b][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/8937/8937-1623660542-1697032253.png[/img]

﻿﻿Junimo Dialog[/b] lets your Junimos tell you how they really feel.

They'll occasionally spout off about work, life, feelings, seasons, weather, and harvests.

The dialog ranges between happy, sassy, and grumbling. If you don't want the attitude, or you [b]only[/b] want the attitude, it's configurable.

You can add or modify the dialog, including having custom dialog for [size=3]specific days/times/weather/festivals etc[/size]. You can do it! Even if you haven't modded before.

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2221]Better Junimos[/url] but also works fine on its own.
[/size]
